register.title: The design solar flux is set for the wrong part of the solar cycle
register.why: Drag, and with it propellant, lifetime and the thrust margin, scale with F10.7. A centre that does not follow the cycle sizes a mission on the declining half of cycle 25 for a sky 26 per cent brighter than the record says — carrying propellant it does not need — or leaves one flying into a stronger cycle short. The level is the owner's to confirm.

moves.label: F10.7 central expectation at a lead
moves.learned: The constant was 26 per cent high for a five-year mission opening in 2027 — the record ran at 91.2 sfu over that span, scaled onto cycle 25. The unconditional mean is right only once the window spans more than a cycle.

moves.label: F10.7 central expectation at a lead
moves.learned: Cycles repeat their shape and not their size, so beyond cycle 25 the amplitude was a guess; and the 45-day grid did not divide the period, which left a 1.2 sfu discontinuity at the wrap that no reading of the numbers would have found.
